title: Correct coupling force
description: Essential: The answer must give the force between the 5th and 6th cars during acceleration as 3.6 × 10⁴ N (or equivalent).

title: Correct acceleration time
description: Essential: The answer must give the time of uniform acceleration as 25 s (or equivalent).

title: Correct maximum speed
description: Essential: The answer must give the maximum speed as 75 m/s (or equivalent).

title: Free-body diagram reasoning
description: Important: The solution must correctly isolate cars 6-8 and apply Newton's second law (F_net = ma) to find the coupling force.

title: Power balance at max speed
description: Important: The solution must equate the total motor power (2P₀) to the total resistive power (8F_f * v_max) to find the maximum speed.

title: Resistance force calculation
description: Important: The solution must correctly calculate the resistance per car as f = 0.01mg.

title: Acceleration phase power use
description: Optional: The solution may correctly relate motor power, traction force, and instantaneous velocity during acceleration to find the acceleration time.

title: Sign error in coupling force
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the calculated coupling force is a compressive force (negative) or incorrectly treats the direction of the force.

title: Power or force unit mismatch
description: Pitfall: Penalize if there is a unit inconsistency (e.g., not converting kW to W, or kg to N) leading to an incorrect numerical factor.

title: Incorrect system isolation
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the wrong set of cars (e.g., 1-5 instead of 6-8) is used to analyze the coupling force between the 5th and 6th cars.
